none: PAS NLM-19D420: Barton upon Humber: Roman Coin Nummus of Valens or Valentinian I
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy. Coin, Nummus, Valens or Valentinian I, 364-378. Diameter: 16.84mm, Weight: 1.75gms. Reverse inscription: (GLORIA RO) [M]ANORUM Reverse design: Emperor with a standard going Right dragging a captive. Letters appear both side of standard. Reverse fields: Four unclear letters, two either side of standard; that at top right appears as II. Cliff Reeves kindly corrected notes by MF
